original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
original.text: Where a woman under eighteen years of age is raped by one or more persons constituting a group or acting in furtherance of a common intention, each of those persons shall be deemed to have committed the offence of rape and shall be punished with imprisonment for life, which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person’s natural life, and with fine, or with death: Provided that such fine shall be just and reasonable to meet the medical expenses and rehabilitation of the victim: Provided further that any fine imposed under this sub-section shall be paid to the victim. Punishment for repeat offenders.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 5: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
Section 70: Gang rape.
Where a woman under eighteen years of age is raped by one or more persons constituting a group or acting in furtherance of a common intention, each of those persons shall be deemed to have committed the offence of rape and shall be punished with imprisonment for life, which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person’s natural life, and with fine, or with death: Provided that such fine shall be just and reasonable to meet the medical expenses and rehabilitation of the victim: Provided further that any fine imposed under this sub-section shall be paid to the victim. Punishment for repeat offenders.

original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD

original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
original.text:
Whoever, by deceitful means or by making promise to marry to
a woman without any intention of fulfilling the same, has sexual intercourse
with her, such sexual intercourse not amounting to the offence of rape,
shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which
may extend to ten years and shall also be liable to fine.
Explanation.—“deceitful means” shall include inducement for, or false
promise of employment or promotion, or marrying by suppressing identity.
Gang rape.

original.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
original.text: Whoever has been previously convicted of an offence punishable under section 64 or section 65 or section 66 or section 70 and is subsequently convicted of an offence punishable under any of the said sections shall be punished with imprisonment for life which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person’s natural life, or with death. Disclosure of identity of victim of certain offences, etc.

Section 71: Punishment for repeat offenders.
Whoever has been previously convicted of an offence punishable under section 64 or section 65 or section 66 or section 70 and is subsequently convicted of an offence punishable under any of the said sections shall be punished with imprisonment for life which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person’s natural life, or with death. original.chapter_title: OF ABETMENT, CRIMINAL CONSPIRACY AND ATTEMPT
original.text: Whoever attempts to commit an offence punishable by this Sanhita with imprisonment for life or imprisonment, or to cause such an offence to be committed, and in such attempt does any act towards the commission of the offence, shall, where no express provision is made by this Sanhita for the punishment of such attempt, be punished with imprisonment of any description provided for the offence, for a term which may extend to one-half of the imprisonment for life or, as the case may be, one-half of the longest term of imprisonment provided for that offence, or with such fine as is provided for the offence, or with both.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 4: OF ABETMENT, CRIMINAL CONSPIRACY AND ATTEMPT
Section 62: Punishment for attempting to commit offences punishable with imprisonment for life or other
Whoever attempts to commit an offence punishable by this Sanhita with imprisonment for life or imprisonment, or to cause such an offence to be committed, and in such attempt does any act towards the commission of the offence, shall, where no express provision is made by this Sanhita for the punishment of such attempt, be punished with imprisonment of any description provided for the offence, for a term which may extend to one-half of the imprisonment for life or, as the case may be, one-half of the longest term of imprisonment provided for that offence, or with such fine as is provided for the offence, or with both.

original.text: Whoever, having been convicted by a Court in India, of an offence punishable under Chapter X or Chapter XVII of this Sanhita with imprisonment of either description for a term of three years or upwards, shall be guilty of any offence punishable under either of those Chapters with like imprisonment for the like term, shall be subject for every such subsequent offence to imprisonment for life, or to imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years. GENERAL EXCEPTIONS Act done by a person bound, or by mistake of fact believing himself bound, by law.
original.derived_context:
Act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
Chapter 2: OF PUNISHMENTS
Section 13: Enhanced punishment for certain offences after previous conviction.
Whoever, having been convicted by a Court in India, of an offence punishable under Chapter X or Chapter XVII of this Sanhita with imprisonment of either description for a term of three years or upwards, shall be guilty of any offence punishable under either of those Chapters with like imprisonment for the like term, shall be subject for every such subsequent offence to imprisonment for life, or to imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years. GENERAL EXCEPTIONS Act done by a person bound, or by mistake of fact believing himself bound, by law.

Whoever attempts to commit an offence punishable by this Sanhita with imprisonment for life or imprisonment, or to cause such an offence to be committed, and in such attempt does any act towards the commission of the offence, shall, where no express provision is made by this Sanhita for the punishment of such attempt, be punished with imprisonment of any description provided for the offence, for a term which may extend to one-half of the imprisonment for life or, as the case may be, one-half of the longest term of imprisonment provided for that offence, or with such fine as is provided for the offence, or with both.

phase11.detailed_answer: Under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, if a woman is raped by one or more persons acting in furtherance of a common intention, the punishment is rigorous imprisonment for a term not less than twenty years, which may extend to life imprisonment (Section 70(1)). If the victim is under eighteen years of age, the punishment is life imprisonment or death (Section 70(2)). Additionally, if the victim is under twelve years of age, the punishment is also life imprisonment or death (Section 65(2)).

top_sections.section_title: Punishment for rape in certain cases.

llm_evidence.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
llm_evidence.text: Where a woman under eighteen years of age is raped by one or more persons constituting a group or acting in furtherance of a common intention, each of those persons shall be deemed to have committed the offence of rape and shall be punished with imprisonment for life, which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person’s natural life, and with fine, or with death: Provided that such fine shall be just and reasonable to meet the medical expenses and rehabilitation of the victim: Provided further that any fine imposed under this sub-section shall be paid to the victim. Punishment for repeat offenders.

llm_evidence.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
llm_evidence.text: Where a woman is raped by one or more persons constituting a group or acting in furtherance of a common intention, each of those persons shall be deemed to have committed the offence of rape and shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than twenty years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person’s natural life, and with fine: Provided that such fine shall be just and reasonable to meet the medical expenses and rehabilitation of the victim: Provided further that any fine imposed under this sub-section shall be paid to the victim.

llm_evidence.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
llm_evidence.text: Whoever, except in the cases provided for in sub-section (2), commits rape, shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than ten years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

llm_evidence.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
llm_evidence.citation: Section 69: Sexual intercourse by employing deceitful means, etc.
llm_evidence.text: Whoever, by deceitful means or by making promise to marry to a woman without any intention of fulfilling the same, has sexual intercourse with her, such sexual intercourse not amounting to the offence of rape, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years and shall also be liable to fine. Explanation.—“deceitful means” shall include inducement for, or false promise of employment or promotion, or marrying by suppressing identity. Gang rape.

llm_evidence.chapter_title: OF OFFENCES AGAINST WOMAN AND CHILD
llm_evidence.text: Whoever, commits rape on a woman under twelve years of age shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than twenty years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life, which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person’s natural life, and with fine or with death: Provided that such fine shall be just and reasonable to meet the medical expenses and rehabilitation of the victim: Provided further that any fine imposed under this sub-section shall be paid to the victim. Punishment for causing death or resulting in persistent vegetative state of victim.
